baseline_policy: Reuse all 344 pinned original emitted baseline outcomes; retain their original ghost/OOD/failure policy. Never apply the new compiler ghost=0 filter to historical baselines.

historical_failure_context.use: Diagnostic historical context only; not used to select the new main cohort.
Diagnostic historical context only; not used to select the new main cohort.

historical_fixed_layout_timing.aggregation: Within each run subtract initial placement from full compile and divide search kernel by that remainder. Take each circuit's 3-repetition medians; then across 12 circuits take the time median and arithmetic mean of the search shares.
historical_fixed_layout_timing.nested_stage_policy: forecast and return_match are nested in search_kernel and must not be summed again.
historical_fixed_layout_timing.scope: Historical SA-initialized M4 runs under saved fixed starting mappings; remaining full compilation after initial placement. Not new physical-GA total compilation time.

historical_fixed_mapping_budget_timing.aggregation: For each original run compute full_compile_ns-initial_placement_ns. Pair each circuit variant with its same-circuit default, then take the geometric mean of 12 ratios. There is one original run per configuration/circuit; no aggregation subtraction and no timing-repeat interpretation.
historical_fixed_mapping_budget_timing.quantity: Remaining full-compilation interval after removing the complete initialization stage; not pure dynamic kernel time.
historical_fixed_mapping_budget_timing.scope: Observed historical four-worker ablation time ratios, separate from the serial fixed-layout timing group and from new physical-GA end-to-end compilation time.

timing_context.interpretation: Observed ratios within the historical sensitivity execution, which allowed four concurrent jobs. These are not the independent serial timing experiment or end-to-end GA-initialization runtime.

historical_fixed_mapping_budget_timing.verification: 36 manifest hashes and timing fields rechecked; per-run stage differences and 12 paired ratios independently recomputed. Saved mapping equality is bound by the pinned derivation audit; traces are not reread.

reuse_policy: Reuse all 27 identical pilot GA-H2 circuit/seed outcomes: 24 successes and three timeouts. Preserve their source identities and scheduling context; do not retry failures or relabel their timing as fresh.
timing_policy: Fourteen-worker parallel quality execution; wall-clock time is descriptive only, not serial runtime evidence. Reused pilot timing belongs to its original mixed scheduling protocol.
verification: Validated worker evidence + hash closure; independently recomputed saved-score consistency, eligibility, aggregates and macros. No export-stage trace replay or physical simulation.
